entries.name: agent-env-backup
entries.description: Human-controlled encrypted backup/restore CLI for agent environments. AES-256-GCM with a 12-word seed as the sole passphrase; nothing written unencrypted. Checklist-driven restore with confirmation gates and an action allow-list. Local-first.
entries.notes: Optional Tessera destination is a documented stub in this release (ordinary per_action client object design; not wired).
